notes: TEST build. Paint engine v2: one formula — every paint is ten numbers (fluidity, body, opacity, gloss, grain, strength, staining, granulation, drying, tack); presets are named points, in-between is a smooth new medium; old brushes paint as before, Ink exactly. Dry brush leaves strips along the stroke; strands; a dirty brush picks up from the sheet. Drips are a curtain of soft tongues; a very wet wash feathers along the paper; wet sheet. Oil gloss is small broken highlights on ridges only; a flat turns behind the hand; the first touch lays more.
